context:
Goal: a day's-end check of what came and what is short.
Problem (goal): the view needs a way in.
Based on (read): decision ux-control-earns-place (a control earns its place).
Departs from: main's empty query shows the start hint — it shows today's pile once a card is in today.
Asked by lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237, mockup docs/design/duo-hand-gaps.html at 4362dc5). The picks per part live in docs/design/duo-hand-gaps-notes.md.

options.how: Once one card is in today, an empty query shows the day's pile and what is not normal.
options.label: The empty query
options.lose: It appears without being asked for.

options.how: A Day's end button in the header opens the same view.
options.label: A Day's end control
options.lose: One more control, and a state to leave.

ref: debt duo-hand-mockup-gaps; decision duo-card-in-hand; lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237)
title: What opens the End of mail day view: an empty query, or a Day's end control?
why: No new control, and the day shows exactly when the pile is done.
